 Free landfill day in San Antonio this weekend: What you can bring
 Bring a photo ID and a copy of your recent CPS Energy bill
 Rebecca Salinas , Executive Producer
 Published:  November 11, 2026 at 11:45 AM Tags:  San Antonio , Litter , Landfills Do you have bulky waste, like tires or old mattresses? On Saturday, you just might be able to dispose of these items. (Magda Ehlers/Pexels stock photo) SAN ANTONIO – San Antonio residents can get rid of unwanted bulky waste for free this weekend during another Free Landfill Day.
 The event is scheduled for Saturday, Nov. 14, from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. at two landfill locations:
 Republic Services Landfill: 7000 Interstate 10 E., San Antonio, TX 78219 
 Waste Management Landfill: 8611 Covel Road, San Antonio, TX 78252 
 Items accepted include:
 Appliances 
 Furniture and mattresses 
 Carpet and fencing materials 
 Toilets and water heaters 
 Tires (limited to six passenger car tires per household) 
 Bagged litter (landfills only) 
 People must bring a valid ID and a current CPS Energy bill showing the Environmental Fee as proof of residency.
 Officials also remind residents to cover their loads with a tarp before heading to the landfill.
